title: Describe the result you need
body: Give your bot a brief, a deadline and an example of what a finished report should look like.
heading: Give your bot a job to finish.

title: Choose what it can use
body: Point your bot to the records it needs and specify which tools it can use for this task.
heading: Give your bot a job to finish.

title: Keep the brief in view
body: Add a correction to the conversation so your bot can pick up the latest instructions.
heading: Give your bot a job to finish.

title: Follow the work in progress
body: See which sources your bot has checked and what it still needs to finish.
heading: Give your bot a job to finish.

title: Step in at a decision
body: Have your bot flag a missing detail or ask for approval before it sends a reply.
heading: Give your bot a job to finish.

title: Review the finished work
body: Open the draft alongside its sources, check the details and send back any edits.
heading: Give your bot a job to finish.

title: Schedule
body: Automate recurring work by choosing when and how often Innflow should run.
heading: Give every step a clear owner.

title: Trigger
body: Choose an event and define what Innflow should do when it happens.
heading: Give every step a clear owner.

title: Advanced automation
body: Describe when Innflow should act and what it should do in your own words.
heading: Give every step a clear owner.

title: Resume after approval
body: Pause at a review step. Once the owner approves, carry the decision into the next action.
heading: Give every step a clear owner.

title: Give a project its own channel
body: Bring teammates, agents and the project brief together so everyone starts with the same context.
heading: Work with agents in one conversation.

title: Bring an agent into the thread
body: Mention an agent beside a question or file and tell it what you need back.
heading: Work with agents in one conversation.

title: Keep side conversations connected
body: Work through a follow-up in a thread while the main channel stays focused on the project.
heading: Work with agents in one conversation.

title: Find the decision later
body: Return to the answer, its supporting files and the conversation where your team agreed on the next step.
heading: Work with agents in one conversation.

title: Show it a browser task
body: Walk through a weekly report so your agent can see which dashboard, filters and export you use.
heading: Put your agent to work in the browser.

title: Send it to the right record
body: Name the site and the ticket or order to look up. Ask for the details you need from that page.
heading: Put your agent to work in the browser.

title: Prepare a form for review
body: Give your agent the values to enter and a stopping point before it submits the form.
heading: Put your agent to work in the browser.

title: Check what came back
body: Review the exported report or the prepared fields. Resolve any missing information before the next step.
heading: Put your agent to work in the browser.
